extensions.claim_text: As of December 31, 2020 Ring had derivative contracts covering 9,000 barrels of oil per day for 2021 (4,500 in costless collars at $52.71-$55.35 ceiling, 4,500 in swaps at $45.00-$45.96) and 1,750 bpd
extensions.source_label: TX RRC monthly oil production by operator (Form PR)
extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://webapps.rrc.texas.gov/PR/publicMonthlyOnlineQueryAction.do — Form PR monthly production by operator number, by county
extensions.rationale: Hedging 9,000 bpd implies actual production OF AT LEAST that magnitude (operators typically hedge 50-80% of expected production). TX RRC Form PR is the regulator-side ground truth for monthly produced barrels — the direct operational-capacity test of the implied 11,000-18,000 bpd total production scale.
extensions.expected_observable: Ring Energy monthly oil production 2020-2021 in the named counties, summed across leases
extensions.signal_direction: if RRC PR shows production << 9,000 bpd then hedging exceeds production (suspicious); if RRC shows ~11,000-18,000 bpd then hedge ratio is normal
